descriptionChirho: A woman who engages in sexual acts for payment or as a profession; used both literally of actual prostitutes and figuratively of spiritual unfaithfulness (as in Revelation's 'great harlot'). Consistently translated across languages: Spanish 'ramera/prostituta', Hindi 'veshya' (वेश्या), Arabic 'zaniya' (زَانِيَة), Korean 'changnyeo' (창녀) and 'eumnyeo' (음녀), Swahili 'kahaba'. The three clusters are merely singular case inflections, plural forms, and a genitive construction of the identical lexical sense.
